1: # Implementation Tasks
2: 
3: **Note**: Tasks are organized by implementation phase (models → UI → rendering → export → testing) rather than by capability. Text and sticker elements share common infrastructure (CanvasElement model, gestures, persistence, export), so they are implemented together where it makes sense, but they are **separate functional areas** defined in distinct spec deltas (`text-elements` and `sticker-elements`).
4: 
5: ## 1. Data Model & Architecture
6: 
7: - [ ] 1.1 Create `InstaBorderApp/Models/CanvasElement.swift` with enum supporting Image, Text, and Sticker cases
8:   - Define `enum CanvasElement: Identifiable, Codable`
9:   - Case `.image(ImageElement)` - wraps existing CanvasImage data
10:   - Case `.text(TextElement)` - text with formatting
11:   - Case `.sticker(StickerElement)` - emoji or SF Symbol
12:   - Each case has `id: UUID`, `position: CGPoint`, `scale: CGFloat`, `rotation: Angle`
13: 
14: - [ ] 1.2 Define `ImageElement` struct to wrap existing CanvasImage properties
15:   - `image: UIImage` (proxy, 1200px)
16:   - `originalImageId: UUID?` (for loading from `/Caches/original_images/`)
17:   - `adjustments: PhotoAdjustments`
18:   - Codable using existing CanvasImage encoding logic
19: 
20: - [ ] 1.3 Define `TextElement` struct with properties
21:   - `text: String`
22:   - `font: String` (font name, e.g., "SF Pro", "Helvetica")
23:   - `fontSize: CGFloat` (12-72pt)
24:   - `color: Color` (text color, use existing Color Codable extension)
25:   - `alignment: TextAlignment` (left, center, right)
26:   - `backgroundColor: Color?` (nil = transparent)
27:   - `backgroundOpacity: Double` (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = solid)
28: 
29: - [ ] 1.4 Define `StickerElement` struct with properties
30:   - `type: StickerType` enum (emoji, sfSymbol)
31:   - `content: String` (emoji character or SF Symbol name)
32:   - `color: Color?` (for SF Symbols, nil for emoji)
33:   - `size: CGFloat` (base size before scale transform)
34: 
35: - [ ] 1.5 Add computed properties to CanvasElement for unified access
36:   - `var id: UUID` - returns element's unique ID
37:   - `var position: CGPoint` - get/set position regardless of type
38:   - `var scale: CGFloat` - get/set scale regardless of type
39:   - `var rotation: Angle` - get/set rotation regardless of type
40: 
41: ## 2. GridViewModel Extension
42: 
43: - [ ] 2.1 Update `GridViewModel.swift` to use new CanvasElement model
44:   - Keep existing `images: [CanvasImage]` temporarily for migration
45:   - Add `@Published var elements: [CanvasElement] = []`
46:   - Add migration function to convert old `CanvasImage` to `CanvasElement.image(ImageElement)`
47: 
48: - [ ] 2.2 Add element management methods to GridViewModel
49:   - `func addImageElement(_ image: UIImage, at position: CGPoint)` - wrap existing addImage logic
50:   - `func addTextElement(text: String, font: String, fontSize: CGFloat, color: Color, at position: CGPoint)`
51:   - `func addStickerElement(type: StickerType, content: String, at position: CGPoint)`
52:   - `func updateElement(id: UUID, with updatedElement: CanvasElement)`
53:   - `func deleteElement(id: UUID)` - remove by ID and add to undo stack
54: 
55: - [ ] 2.3 Extend undo/redo system in GridViewModel
56:   - Update `saveSnapshot()` to capture entire `elements` array state
57:   - Update `undo()` and `redo()` to restore `elements` array
58:   - Test that snapshots are created on: add element, delete element, edit text, transform element
59: 
60: - [ ] 2.4 Update auto-save persistence in GridViewModel
61:   - Modify `GridAutoSaveConfig` struct (lines 615-620) to include `elements: [CanvasElement]`
62:   - Remove old `images: [SavedCanvasImage]` field
63:   - Update `saveToUserDefaults()` to encode CanvasElement array
64:   - Handle backward compatibility: if old format detected, migrate to new format
65: 
66: - [ ] 2.5 Update restore logic in GridViewModel
67:   - Modify `restoreFromUserDefaults()` to decode CanvasElement array
68:   - For text/sticker elements: recreate directly from saved data (lightweight)
69:   - For image elements: load proxy from `/Caches/autosave_images/{uuid}.jpg`
70:   - Add migration path: if loading old format, convert CanvasImage → CanvasElement.image
71: 
72: ## 3. Text Editing UI
73: 
74: - [ ] 3.1 Create `InstaBorderApp/Views/Components/TextEditorView.swift`
75:   - SwiftUI sheet view with `@Binding var textElement: TextElement?`
76:   - TextField for text input (multi-line support with TextEditor)
77:   - Live preview of text with current formatting below input
78:   - "Done" button to confirm and dismiss sheet
79: 
80: - [ ] 3.2 Add font picker with common system fonts
81:   - Use Picker with ForEach over available fonts
82:   - Fonts: "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "Georgia", "Courier New", "Times New Roman", "Arial", "Menlo"
83:   - Display font name in its own font style in picker
84: 
85: - [ ] 3.2.1 Add font availability validation
86:   - Create runtime check: `UIFont(name: fontName, size: 24) != nil`
87:   - Fallback to "SF Pro Text" if requested font unavailable
88:   - Ensure compatibility across iOS 13+ versions
89: 
90: - [ ] 3.3 Add font size slider with real-time preview
91:   - Slider range: 12pt to 72pt, step 1pt
92:   - Display current size value next to slider (e.g., "36 pt")
93:   - Update preview text size in real-time as slider moves
94: 
95: - [ ] 3.4 Add text color picker
96:   - Reuse existing `ColorPickerButton` from GridEditingView
97:   - Default color: black
98:   - Show color swatch next to "Color" label
99: 
100: - [ ] 3.5 Add text alignment buttons
101:   - HStack with 3 buttons: Left, Center, Right
102:   - Use SF Symbols: "text.alignleft", "text.aligncenter", "text.alignright"
103:   - Highlight selected alignment option
104:   - Note: Alignment affects multi-line text only
105: 
106: - [ ] 3.6 Add background options with picker
107:   - Segmented picker: "None", "Solid", "Semi-transparent"
108:   - If Solid/Semi-transparent selected, show background color picker
109:   - Solid = opacity 1.0, Semi-transparent = opacity 0.5
110:   - Show preview with background in real-time
111: 
112: - [ ] 3.7 Add "Add Text" button to `GridEditingView.swift` toolbar
113:   - Add button next to existing "Add Photos" button (use SF Symbol "textformat")
114:   - On tap: create default TextElement and show TextEditorView sheet
115:   - Default: text="Double tap to edit", font="SF Pro Text", size=24pt, color=black, position=canvas center
116: 
117: - [ ] 3.8 Enable editing existing text elements
118:   - In GridCanvasView, add .onTapGesture(count: 2) to text elements (double-tap pattern)
119:   - On double-tap: set selectedElement and show TextEditorView sheet with current values
120:   - Save changes on "Done", discard on sheet dismiss without changes
121:   - Note: Double-tap avoids conflict with drag gesture, follows iOS conventions
122: 
123: ## 4. Sticker Picker UI
124: 
125: - [ ] 4.1 Create `InstaBorderApp/Views/Components/StickerPickerView.swift`
126:   - Sheet view with TabView: "Emoji" tab and "Icons" tab
127:   - Callback: `var onSelect: (StickerElement) -> Void`
128:   - Dismiss sheet automatically after selection
129: 
130: - [ ] 4.2 Integrate existing EmojiPickerView as Emoji tab
131:   - Reference: `InstaBorderApp/Views/Components/EmojiPickerView.swift`
132:   - Reuse existing 8 categories and 20 emoji per category
133:   - On emoji selection: create StickerElement(type: .emoji, content: emoji) and call onSelect
134: 
135: - [ ] 4.3 Create `IconPickerView.swift` for SF Symbols
136:   - Create categories dictionary mapping category names to SF Symbol arrays
137:   - Categories and symbols (15-20 per category):
138:     - "Arrows": ["arrow.up", "arrow.down", "arrow.left", "arrow.right", "arrow.up.circle.fill", "arrow.down.circle.fill", "arrow.left.circle.fill", "arrow.right.circle.fill", "arrow.turn.up.right", "arrow.turn.down.left", "arrow.uturn.backward", "arrow.uturn.forward", "arrow.clockwise", "arrow.counterclockwise", "chevron.up", "chevron.down"]
139:     - "Shapes": ["circle.fill", "square.fill", "triangle.fill", "heart.fill", "star.fill", "diamond.fill", "hexagon.fill", "octagon.fill", "shield.fill", "flag.fill", "bookmark.fill", "cloud.fill", "moon.fill", "sun.max.fill", "sparkle"]
140:     - "Communication": ["message.fill", "phone.fill", "envelope.fill", "paperplane.fill", "bubble.left.fill", "bubble.right.fill", "ellipsis.bubble.fill", "quote.bubble.fill", "text.bubble.fill", "exclamationmark.bubble.fill", "questionmark.bubble.fill", "mic.fill", "speaker.wave.2.fill", "bell.fill", "video.fill"]
141:     - "Weather": ["sun.max.fill", "cloud.fill", "cloud.rain.fill", "cloud.snow.fill", "cloud.bolt.fill", "moon.stars.fill", "sparkles", "wind", "tornado", "hurricane", "snowflake", "thermometer.sun.fill", "thermometer.snowflake", "drop.fill", "humidity.fill"]
142:     - "Nature": ["leaf.fill", "flame.fill", "drop.fill", "snowflake", "sparkles", "tree.fill", "mountain.2.fill", "sunrise.fill", "sunset.fill", "moon.fill", "star.fill", "cloud.sun.fill", "cloud.moon.fill", "rainbow", "flower"]
143:     - "Objects": ["lightbulb.fill", "camera.fill", "music.note", "gift.fill", "book.fill", "bookmark.fill", "graduationcap.fill", "briefcase.fill", "hammer.fill", "wrench.fill", "paintbrush.fill", "cup.and.saucer.fill", "cart.fill", "bag.fill", "key.fill"]
144:   - Display as scrollable category sections with LazyVGrid (4 columns)
145:   - Each icon shown at 32pt size with .fill variant where available
146: 
147: - [ ] 4.4 Add search functionality for SF Symbols
148:   - TextField at top of Stickers tab with search icon
149:   - Filter icons across all categories by name match
150:   - Show filtered results in single grid (no categories when searching)
151:   - Clear search on category selection
152: 
153: - [ ] 4.5 Add "Add Sticker" button to `GridEditingView.swift` toolbar
154:   - Add button next to "Add Text" button (use SF Symbol "face.smiling")
155:   - On tap: show StickerPickerView sheet
156:   - Position new sticker at canvas center with default size 64pt
157: 
158: - [ ] 4.6 Handle sticker selection and placement
159:   - In StickerPickerView onSelect callback: create StickerElement
160:   - Call GridViewModel.addStickerElement(type:content:at:)
161:   - Dismiss sheet after selection
162:   - Add new sticker to canvas at center position
163: 
164: ## 5. Canvas Rendering
165: 
166: - [ ] 5.1 Update `GridCanvasView.swift` to render all element types
167:   - Replace ForEach over `viewModel.images` with ForEach over `viewModel.elements`
168:   - Use switch statement on element type to render appropriate view
169:   - Case .image: render existing SingleImageView (reuse current implementation)
170:   - Case .text: render new TextElementView component
171:   - Case .sticker: render new StickerElementView component
172: 
173: - [ ] 5.2 Create `InstaBorderApp/Views/Components/TextElementView.swift`
174:   - Accept `@Binding var element: TextElement` and gesture bindings
175:   - Render Text view with textElement.text, font, fontSize, color
176:   - If backgroundColor exists, add background rectangle with specified opacity
177:   - Apply multilineTextAlignment based on textElement.alignment
178:   - Make text fixed width for alignment to work correctly
179:   - Apply .rotationEffect() and .scaleEffect() transforms
180: 
181: - [ ] 5.3 Create `InstaBorderApp/Views/Components/StickerElementView.swift`
182:   - Accept `@Binding var element: StickerElement` and gesture bindings
183:   - For type .emoji: render Text view with emoji character at specified size
184:   - For type .sfSymbol: render Image(systemName: content) with .foregroundColor(color)
185:   - Apply .rotationEffect() and .scaleEffect() transforms
186:   - Ensure hit testing works correctly for gestures
187: 
188: - [ ] 5.4 Ensure uniform transform application across element types
189:   - All elements positioned via .position(element.position)
190:   - All elements scaled via .scaleEffect(element.scale)
191:   - All elements rotated via .rotationEffect(element.rotation)
192:   - Transform order: scale → rotate → position (consistent with SingleImageView)
193: 
194: - [ ] 5.5 Implement Z-order rendering
195:   - Elements render in array order: viewModel.elements[0] (back) to elements[n-1] (front)
196:   - Use .zIndex(Double(index)) to ensure correct layering even with gestures
197:   - When element is being dragged, temporarily increase its zIndex to appear on top
198: 
199: - [ ] 5.6 Add Z-order controls to element selection overlay
200:   - When element selected (long-press), show action buttons including:
201:     - "Bring to Front" button (SF Symbol: "square.3.layers.3d.top.filled")
202:     - "Send to Back" button (SF Symbol: "square.3.layers.3d.bottom.filled")
203:   - Apply to ALL element types (images, text, stickers) for consistency
204:   - On "Bring to Front": move element to end of array (viewModel.elements.append)
205:   - On "Send to Back": move element to start of array (viewModel.elements.insert(at: 0))
206:   - Trigger undo snapshot before Z-order change
207:   - Update existing image action overlay to include Z-order buttons
208: 
209: ## 6. Gesture Interactions
210: 
211: - [ ] 6.1 Add unified drag gesture handling for all element types
212:   - Extract existing DragGesture logic from SingleImageView
213:   - Create shared gesture handler in GridCanvasView
214:   - On drag: update element.position with translation
215:   - Apply smart snapping to canvas edges (reuse existing snapPosition logic)
216:   - Trigger haptic feedback on snap
217: 
218: - [ ] 6.2 Add unified pinch-zoom gesture for text and sticker elements
219:   - Use MagnificationGesture() similar to image handling
220:   - On pinch: update element.scale (constrain to 0.3× - 4.0× range)
221:   - For text: scale uniformly (both width and height)
222:   - For stickers: scale uniformly maintaining aspect ratio
223: 
224: - [ ] 6.3 Add unified rotation gesture for text and sticker elements
225:   - Use RotationGesture() similar to image handling
226:   - On rotation: update element.rotation
227:   - Apply smart snapping to 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° (within 5° threshold)
228:   - Trigger haptic feedback on rotation snap
229: 
230: - [ ] 6.4 Add simultaneous gesture support
231:   - Use .simultaneously(with:) to allow drag + pinch + rotate at same time
232:   - Match behavior of existing SingleImageView gestures
233:   - Ensure gestures don't conflict with canvas pan/zoom
234: 
235: - [ ] 6.5 Add long-press selection for text and sticker elements
236:   - LongPressGesture (0.5 second duration)
237:   - On long-press: set @State var selectedElementId: UUID?
238:   - Show selection overlay with action buttons centered on element
239:   - Deselect on tap outside element or on another element
240: 
241: - [ ] 6.6 Create element action overlay view
242:   - Show when selectedElementId is not nil
243:   - Display buttons in HStack above selected element:
244:     - Text: "Edit" (textformat.abc), "Delete" (trash), "Bring to Front", "Send to Back"
245:     - Sticker: "Delete" (trash), "Bring to Front", "Send to Back"
246:   - Button style: small, rounded, white background with shadow
247:   - Position overlay centered above element with 20pt offset
248: 
249: - [ ] 6.7 Test gesture interactions don't interfere
250:   - Dragging one element doesn't affect others
